name: Tag
summary: A label for one piece of data — a category, a state, a filter. The outlined member of the chip family, so it can sit beside a filled badge without either of them winning.
summaryZh: 给一段数据贴的标签 —— 分类、状态、筛选项。这个家族里描边的是标签,所以它可以和实心徽标并排放,谁也不压过谁。

props.name: variant
props.description: Which state this tag carries. The base class on its own is the neutral tag.
props.descriptionZh: 这个标签表示哪一种状态。只写基类就是中性标签。

a11y.notes: The tag is text inside a plain <span>: it is read where it sits and it is never focusable. If the tag is meant to be clicked or removed, use a real <button> or <a> and keep the class on it — a clickable span is not focusable and is not announced as a control.
a11y.notesZh: 标签就是 <span> 里的一段文字,在哪儿就读到哪儿,也永远不进 Tab 顺序。如果这个标签是可以点、可以删的,请用真正的 <button> 或 <a>,把类留在它身上就行 —— 可点的 span 不可聚焦,读屏也不会把它当成控件。

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: The base class on its own is the neutral tag: the theme's default border on the plain surface. The four variants tint the fill and outline it with the derived brand colour.
examples.descriptionZh: 只写基类就是中性标签:主题默认的描边,压在素面上。四种变体给底色上淡色,描边则用派生出来的品牌色。
examples.markup: Draft Primary Success Warning Danger

examples.title: In a line of text
examples.description: The tag is inline, so it drops into a sentence the way a word does. Its height comes from the mood, so the line grows a little around it.
examples.descriptionZh: 标签是行内的,像词一样直接落进句子里。它的高度来自 mood,所以行高会稍微给它让一点位置。
examples.markup: Build 214 is passing on all three nodes.

notes: The tag is the outlined member of the soft-chip family. Its border is a derived brand colour (`color-*-text`) rather than a tint of the fill: a tint would sit at about 1.2:1 against the fill, which reads as a smear rather than an edge. `color-*-text` is guaranteed to read on the page, the overlay and the container, so the outline survives every theme.
notesZh: 标签是这个柔和小片家族里负责描边的那一个。它的描边取的是派生品牌色(`color-*-text`),而不是底色的淡化版 —— 淡化版压在底色上只有大约 1.2:1,看着是一道糊痕,不是一条边。`color-*-text` 保证在页面、浮层和容器上都读得清,所以这道描边换到哪套 mood 都还在。
